capLine: Up to 8 people per game, counting the organizer, players, spectators and typed-in players.
potLine: No money moves through Oddable: nothing is collected, held or paid.
invite: Members of the group open each game from the group page.

resultsInfo.live: Scores come in automatically from a public sports feed.
resultsInfo.scorer: No feed: a scorer types results in and the other side (or the commissioner) confirms.
resultsInfo.tbc: ESPN seems to carry this, but the feed has not been confirmed from Oddable yet; until then a scorer enters results.

group-picks.name: Picks contest
group-picks.line: Everyone's bets on one board, graded by Oddable from final scores. Bragging rights only.
group-picks.info: Members compete with the real bets they already track in My Bets (or verified Kalshi bets only). The commissioner sets the rules before the first kickoff: which bets count, how the winner is decided (units, return % or win %), a per-bet cap and minimum bets a week. Other members’ bets stay hidden until their game starts. Bragging rights only: no money moves through Oddable.

pickem.name: Pick'em / confidence pool
pickem.line: Pick every game each week; rank your picks by confidence for more points.
pickem.info: Each week every member picks the winner (or against the spread) of each game. In confidence mode you rank your picks: your surest pick is worth the most points. Picks lock at each game's start. Most points over the season wins.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.line: Pick one team to win each week. Lose and you are out. You cannot use a team twice.
survivor.info: Each week every member picks one team to win. A loss knocks you out; a team can only be used once. Last one standing wins (ties split, or the pool rolls over, as the commissioner sets).

bracket.name: Bracket pick'em
bracket.line: Fill out the whole bracket before it starts; later rounds are worth more.
bracket.info: Everyone fills out the tournament bracket before the first game. Each right pick scores points, more in later rounds. Most points wins; the tiebreak is the final’s total score.

calcutta.name: Calcutta auction
calcutta.line: Bid on teams before it starts. Owners score by how far their team goes.
calcutta.info: Before it starts, members bid on each team (or player) in a live auction. Bids are for the standings only: no money moves through Oddable. Each team’s owner scores for every round the team wins, and the most for the champion.

squares.name: Squares
squares.line: Buy squares on a 10 x 10 grid; the last digits of each quarter’s score win.
squares.info: Members claim squares on a 10 x 10 grid. Numbers 0-9 are drawn for each side after the grid fills. At the end of each quarter (or half), the square matching the last digit of each team’s score wins that period’s share.

tiers.name: Pick-six tiers
tiers.line: Pick one golfer from each of six tiers. Best total score wins.
tiers.info: Golfers are split into six tiers by odds. Each member picks one from each tier before the first tee time. Your best scores are added up (the commissioner sets how many count, and what a missed cut costs). Lowest total wins.

oad.name: One-and-done
oad.line: Pick one player per tournament all season; you can use each player only once.
oad.info: For every tournament in the season each member picks one player and scores that player’s result. You cannot pick the same player twice in the season. Most points at the end wins.

props.name: Props pool
props.line: Answer a sheet of yes/no and over/under questions before it starts.
props.info: The commissioner writes a sheet of questions (first score, total points, MVP...). Members answer before the start. Each right answer scores; most right wins, with a tiebreak question.

winner.name: Pick the winner
winner.line: Pick who wins each race or fight on the card.
winner.info: For every race (or fight) members pick the winner before it starts; optional bonus for method or round. Picks lock at each start. Most points wins.

rr.name: Round robin + playoff
rr.line: Everyone plays everyone. Top finishers can go to a playoff bracket. Scores entered on court.

elim.name: Bracket tournament
elim.line: Single or double elimination, seeded by rating or random draw.

ladder.name: Ladder (weeks long)
ladder.line: Challenge anyone up to a few spots above you. Win and you take the higher spot.

h2h.name: Heads-up challenges
h2h.line: Player vs player or pair vs pair, best of 1, 3 or 5, on the side.

pickem-local.name: Bracket pick'em (spectators)
pickem-local.line: Spectators pick every match before it starts. Most right wins.

solo.name: Solo / skills score
solo.line: A drill or skills game with a number. Works with one player for practice.

team-calcutta.name: Team Calcutta
team-calcutta.line: Auction the players or pairs before play starts. Owners score by how far they go.
team-calcutta.info: Before play, members bid on each player or pair of your own game (for the standings only; no money moves through Oddable). Owners score by how far their entry goes. Uses the Calcutta engine with this game’s entries as the lots.

golf-day.name: Golf day
golf-day.line: A round at one course: each player logs his own score hole by hole, live leaderboard, Golf GPS for the course.
golf-day.info: For a round your group plays together: the commissioner starts a Golf day at a course and picks stroke play gross, stroke play net (each player types their own strokes) or Stableford, over 18, the front 9 or the back 9. Each player logs their own score hole by hole and the leaderboard updates for everyone. Golf GPS shows the course. Skins and match play are not in Golf days yet.

games.name: Pro tour pick'em (PPA, MLP)
games.line: Pick the winner of each pro pickleball match (PPA Tour, Major League Pickleball).
games.info: For each pro pickleball match on the card (PPA Tour tournaments, Major League Pickleball team matches), members pick the winner before the match starts. Picks lock when each match starts. Every right pick scores a point; most points wins.
